statement.p: A population has size 9000 at time t = 0, with t in years.
(a) If the population decreases by 125 people per year, find a formula for the population, P, at time t.
(b) If the population decreases by 6% per year, find a formula for the population, P, at time t.

static.solution:
SOLUTION
a) The population is decreasing linearly, with a slope of -125 people/year, so P(t) = 9000 - 125 t.
b) The population is decreasing exponentially with decay factor 1 - 0.06 = 0.94, so P(t) = 9000 (1- 0.06)^t=9000(0.94)^t
